general_summary: Branco Del-Rio is an architecture studio based in Coimbra. Involved in projects of various scales, we seek and encourage solutions that elevate our relationship with space. Paula del Rio. Soria,1985 Studied architecture at the Technical School of Architecture of Madrid between 2003 and 2010, where she studied the Master en Proyectos Arquitectónicos Avanzados in 2011, when she also started her teaching career as an assistant professor in the chair of Juan Carlos Sancho teaching design of fourth and fifth course. She is currently developing her PhD thesis entitled "La identidad como concepto clave en la ciudad de finales del Siglo XX". Her professional career has developed as a collaborator in the offices of Francisco Mangado in Pamplona and Sancho-Madridejos in Madrid. She ir currently invited Assistant in Design I Studio (1st year) at Darq UC, Coimbra. João Branco. Coimbra, 1983 Studied architecture at the Department of Architecture of the University of Coimbra and ETSA in Barcelona between 2001 and 2008. He studied the Máster en Proyectos Arquitectónicos Avanzados in the departamento de proyectos at the UMP ETSAM in Madrid in 2011 where he teached as a professor assistant in the chair of Juan Carlos Sancho. In 2014 he finished the Energy for Sustainability (EfS) postgraduate studies, an initiative of the University of Coimbra in partnership with MIT Portugal Program. Between 2008 and 2010 he worked in the offices of Jorge Teixeira Dias, BAAS, Jordi Badia and João Mendes Ribeiro. He began working independently in 2011. He currently develops a PhD Thesis in Darq UC, Coimbra, he is a junior reseracher in CES (Centro de Estudos Sociais). In 2018-2019 course he was a Guest Assistant in Design Studio II A (5th year) with Paulo Providência.

Filipe Fonseca da Costa was born in France in 1977. Graduated in Architecture from the Department of Architecture (DARQ) of the University of Coimbra in 2005. He collaborated with the architects Victor Mestre & Sofia Aleixo, in Lisbon, with MX-Si Architectural Studio, in Barcelona, and with Orange studio in Coimbra. He began his activity as an independent architect in 2014, where he has been developing projects in different areas.

Pontoatelier is an architecture office based in Madeira Island, led by the architects Ana Ferreira and Pedro Ribeiro.The practice has developed a wide range of projects, from houses or urban planning to scenographies and furniture.Ponto is interested in the materialization of ideas in the most diverse forms.They combine professional activities such as projects, competitions, exhibitions with research and academic commitment.
They were invited to join the national committee at the 2019 Iberoamerican Bienal. And one of the five architecture studios invited to participate in the national curatorship contest for La Biennale di Venezia 2020.

CNLL leaded by Nuno Lacerda Lopes, Architect and Lecturer at the faculty of Architecture of the University of Porto develops professional activity in areas as Architecture, Engineering, Design and Scenography . With more than twenty years of exhistence, CNLL reflects the values, methodologies, quality criteria and above all his idea of architecture based on man as the central figure of the built space, in an eternal appeal to the senses and a persistent and irreverent desire for experimentation whilst searching for new materials, forms and concepts of which his works are clear evidence.

general_summary:
Nuno Montenegro's office boasts a team that can cater to the full range of technical project planning specialties, from urban planning to the design of public and private developments. The two cornerstones behind its concept are the set of partnerships it has entered into and its drive to foster experimental research. Montenegro's team can provide a design-oriented development concept, the hands-on benefit of a small dynamic company with a well-built network of knowledge connectors, and the technical lead and design expertise of a larger one. In its more than ten years of design practice, the company has earned a reputation for excellence in the master planning and the design of distinctive residential, educational, laboratory facilities, recreational, retail, and mixed-use projects. The approach to projects is collaborative both within the practice itself and in its relationship with clients and consultants, among others. These lines of collaboration are established and maintained right through to the completion of a project, allowing projects, from inception, to be considered holistically - from the aesthetic dimensions to questions regarding the environment, structural integrity, and issues related to cost, program, and value. The office is located near Lisbon, in Portugal, close to the salt marshes of the Tagus River estuary. Its structure occupies the totality of a small historical building in the town center.
